topics.title: eTRRs
topics.subtitle: Enflite's standalone TRR form.
topics.summary: eTRRs: TRRs created on their own, without a Quality Control Topic, in the same layout as Infor's TRRs form.

blocks.text: **Being tested on TRN.** eTRRs is not live in production yet. The vendor **TRRs** form stays in use until go-live.

**eTRRs** is Enflite's TRR form. It looks like Infor's **TRRs** form, but a TRR no longer needs a Quality Control Topic: click **New**, fill it in, save. **Priority**, **Dept** and **Addt'l Topics** are the TRR's own and can be typed. The existing TRRs are copied in from the TRRs form.

The fields the TRR request added (Priority, Dept and Addt'l Topics) are shaded purple on the form. Each Enflite field has a page here. For the fields that work as on Infor's form (Description, the Cause text, Correction/Containment, Corrective Action, Follow Up Date, the User Defined fields), see [Infor's TRRs help](https://docs.infor.com/csi/latest/en-us/csbiolh/default.html?helpcontent=qcs_user_cl_sl/mergedprojects/sl_qcs/forms/nonmaterial/qctrrs.html).
Right-click a field → **Help** (or press **F1**) to open its page.
Built in [Enflite/TRR](https://github.com/Enflite/TRR) (SOW 00002 TRR Development).

topics.title: TRR Num
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the eTRRs form
topics.summary: The TRR's number on eTRRs: TRR- followed by the date and time it was created, for example TRR-260929-111742.

blocks.text: The TRR's number on eTRRs: TRR- followed by the date and time it was created, for example TRR-260929-111742.
How it's filled
Nothing to type. Click **New** and the number fills in. TRRs copied from the TRRs form are numbered TRR- and their old number (for example TRR-1234); the old number on its own is in **Legacy TRR**.

topics.title: Topic Num
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the eTRRs form
topics.summary: The Quality Control Topic this TRR belongs to, if any. A TRR no longer needs a topic.

blocks.text: The Quality Control Topic this TRR belongs to, if any. A TRR no longer needs a topic.
How it's filled
Type the topic number, or leave it blank. TRRs copied from the TRRs form keep their topic number.

topics.title: Legacy TRR
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the eTRRs form
topics.summary: The TRR's number on Infor's TRRs form, for TRRs copied from it. Blank on TRRs created on eTRRs.

blocks.text: The TRR's number on Infor's TRRs form, for TRRs copied from it. Blank on TRRs created on eTRRs.
How it's filled
Filled by **Copy TRRs from vendor form**; it can't be typed. To find an old TRR by its old number, filter on **Legacy TRR** in the grid view.

topics.title: Priority
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the eTRRs form
topics.summary: The TRR's priority code and its description (for example 3, Low). On the TRRs form this came from the topic and couldn't be changed; on eTRRs it is the TRR's own.

blocks.text: The TRR's priority code and its description (for example 3, Low). On the TRRs form this came from the topic and couldn't be changed; on eTRRs it is the TRR's own.
How it's filled
Type the priority code and its description. A drop-down list of the codes is added once the codes are confirmed.

topics.title: Dept
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the eTRRs form

blocks.text: The department the TRR is for, and its description. On the TRRs form this came from the topic; on eTRRs it is the TRR's own.
How it's filled
Pick the department from the list. Its description fills in by itself.

blocks.text: Where the TRR stands, for example Closed.

topics.summary: Other topics this TRR covers. On the TRRs form this came from the topic; on eTRRs it is the TRR's own text.

blocks.text: Other topics this TRR covers. On the TRRs form this came from the topic; on eTRRs it is the TRR's own text.

Type the topics.

topics.summary: The note the TRR started with. On the TRRs form this was the topic's note; on eTRRs it is the TRR's own.

blocks.text: The note the TRR started with. On the TRRs form this was the topic's note; on eTRRs it is the TRR's own.

topics.title: Create Date
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the eTRRs form
topics.summary: The date the TRR was created.

blocks.text: The date the TRR was created.
How it's filled
Filled with today's date on a new TRR. TRRs copied from the TRRs form keep their original date.

topics.title: Created By
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the eTRRs form

blocks.text: Who created the TRR.

topics.title: Due Date
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the eTRRs form
topics.summary: When the TRR is due. On the TRRs form this was the topic's due date and couldn't be changed; on eTRRs it is the TRR's own.

blocks.text: When the TRR is due. On the TRRs form this was the topic's due date and couldn't be changed; on eTRRs it is the TRR's own.
How it's filled
Pick a date from the calendar or type it.

topics.title: Close TRR
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the eTRRs form
topics.summary: Closes the TRR and records when and by whom.

blocks.text: Closes the TRR and records when and by whom.
How it's filled
Tick **Close TRR**: **Close Date** becomes today and **Closed By** your user name, and the TRR saves. Untick it to reopen the TRR: both clear.

topics.title: Costs
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the eTRRs form
topics.summary: The TRR's cost lines: one row per cost, with Sequence, Action, Cost Type, Qty, Unit Cost, Description and Note, as on Infor's TRRs form. On eTRRs the lines are the TRR's own.

blocks.text: The TRR's cost lines: one row per cost, with Sequence, Action, Cost Type, Qty, Unit Cost, Description and Note, as on Infor's TRRs form. On eTRRs the lines are the TRR's own.
How it's filled

On the **Costs** tab, add a row: type the **Sequence** (1, 2, 3 …, unique within the TRR), pick the **Action** and **Cost Type** from their lists, then type **Qty**, **Unit Cost**, **Description** and **Note**, and save. TRRs copied from the TRRs form bring their cost lines with them.

topics.title: Copy TRRs from vendor form
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the eTRRs form
topics.summary: Copies every TRR from Infor's **TRRs** form into eTRRs, with all its fields. Each copied TRR gets a new **TRR Num**; its old number goes in **Legacy TRR**.

blocks.text: Copies every TRR from Infor's **TRRs** form into eTRRs, with all its fields. Each copied TRR gets a new **TRR Num**; its old number goes in **Legacy TRR**.
How it's filled

Click the button on the **User Defined** tab and wait for the message: it says how many TRRs were copied and how many were already here. It is safe to click again: TRRs already copied are skipped. Each TRR's cost lines are copied with it, onto the **Costs** tab.
